test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A can complete one-fourth of a work in 2 days and B can complete three-fifth of the same work in 6 days. In how many days will they complete the work if they work together?
solution:
Formula:

Efficient = Total work ÷ Time taken to complete work individually

Calculation:

According to the question-

A does one-fourth of the work in 2 days.

⇒ A completes the work in 2over{1over4} = 8 days

Similarly, B completes three-fifth of the same work in 6 days
